The shift effectively ends a weird limbo period for a project that wrapped production back in 2023, only to miss its original January 17, 2025, release plan when post wasn’t finished in time. item.description: There was already a sharp eye for taste, insecurity, and youthful self-invention in Chandler Levack’s (“I Like Movies”) work. item.description: “You’re Dating A Narcissist!” is the latest film starring Oscar-winner Marisa Tomei, who leads a cast that also features Sherry Cola, Ciara Bravo, Marco Pigossi, and José María Meza Yazpik.
